name: Kazuki Mirin
source:
Another strange member of class 2-B.
Mirin is a member of the school's Softball team.
Mirin is a cute and beautiful girl who has lots of practice in seducing males. She generally behaves like a hostess because both of her parents were hosts. She always laughs about gaining her practice with her teachers (and she almost tricked one of her principals) through elementary school and junior high school; and now, as a high-school student, she has begun to bloom a talent in this "skill".
